# AvalancheTriggeringMechanism

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The microscopic process by which a local thermal fluctuation overcomes an energy barrier and initiates a chain reaction of thermalization in a quasiperiodic system. Identifying these mechanisms helps design devices that either suppress or harness thermal cascades, impacting thermal management in neuromorphic hardware.
